program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((out0 (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) 4) 0 (at g r c))))))
    (for/fold ([out out0]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 4)) (objects g 0))])
      (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) (if (= (topo-count-holes g obj) 1) 8 2)))))
